---

## Explanation

The whole mental model
XOR everything
     ↓
 get a ^ b
     ↓
find one bit where a,b differ
     ↓
use that bit as a divider
     ↓
split array into 2 groups
     ↓
duplicates cancel inside each group
     ↓
one unique number remains in each group
